Read the [request guide](https://github.com/McGill-Baja-Racing/Strain-Gauge-Requests/blob/main/docs/REQUEST_GUIDE.md). Allow 5–10 minutes; estimates and **TBD** are acceptable initially. Submit one issue per measurement setup and include component quantity. Electronics determines gauges and DAQ requirements. Missing information must be resolved before installation.

## 1. General Information / Measurement

- **Subsystem / Contact:**
- **Component(s) and quantity:**
- **Measurement objective:** What do you want to measure (strain, axial force, bending moment, torque, etc.), and why?
- **Expected operating loads:** Type, directions, minimum–maximum, and units.
- **Basis for load estimates:** Calculations, FEA, previous testing, or assumptions.
- **Component CAD / drawings / photos:** Attach or link.

## 2. Preliminary Calibration Plan

Plan calibration across the full intended force/torque measurement range, including both load directions where applicable. Subsystem leads must adapt their setup if its achievable range falls short. A preliminary concept is enough for submission; equipment and fixture suitability must be confirmed before installation. For local strain without force/torque conversion, describe a suitable validation method instead.

- **How could known loads be applied to the component?** Mounting, constraints, and loading; sketch encouraged. Or describe local strain validation.
- **Proposed calibration load range:** Realistically achievable minimum–maximum, with units; or validation conditions.
- **How will the applied loads be known or measured?** Weights, load cell, lever arm, etc.; or validation reference.
- **Required equipment / fixtures:**
- **Equipment availability:** Check the best match; explain mixed availability below.
  - [ ] Confirmed available
  - [ ] Believed available, not yet verified
  - [ ] Needs to be acquired or manufactured
  - [ ] Unsure
- **Supporting evidence / equipment owner:** Location, photo, inventory, or confirmation if available.
- **Calibration owner:** Person responsible, or TBD.

## 3. Timeline and Priority

Completion means installed, electrically checked, and calibrated or validated, ready to collect usable data. Use dates (YYYY-MM-DD) or TBD.

- **Component available from:**
- **Calibration setup ready by:**
- **Ideal completion date:**
- **Latest acceptable completion date:**
- **Planned testing / data collection date:**
- **Priority justification / consequence of delay:**

## 4. Additional Information

- **Special constraints:** Material, coatings, accessibility, water/mud exposure, wiring limitations, etc.
- **Assistance needed from Electronics / other notes:**

## 5. Electronics Review — Internal Only

- **Review status / outstanding information:**
- **Approved gauge locations and orientations:**
- **Gauge configuration and quantity per component:**
- **Total gauge quantity:**
- **DAQ channels and assigned equipment:**
- **Estimated installation effort and scheduled date:** Include curing, wiring, checks, and calibration time.
- [ ] Initial technical review complete (preliminary estimates and calibration concept acceptable)
- [ ] Installation approved: final locations and equipment selected; component available or delivery confirmed; calibration/validation method feasible, reference equipment and fixtures confirmed, owner identified, and sufficient time scheduled
- [ ] Installation and electrical verification completed
- [ ] Calibration/validation completed and documented (link results):
- [ ] Ready for testing
